_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: What's the latest thinking on using AI coding agents with Unity? How should Claude work in my Unity repo?
Set up this Unity project so Copilot and Claude Code don't break scenes or .meta files.
Which Unity editors are installed and is the editor open?
expectations: the unity-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (unity-agent-cli's job)

evals.prompt: Generate a treasure chest sprite with ComfyUI.
expectations: the unity-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (an image-generation task, not Unity workflow)

evals.prompt: I'm starting a top-down twin-stick shooter in Unity 6. Before we write any code, help me plan the first level and its enemies.
Write me a playtest plan for the first world of my Unity platformer.
Design the enemy waves for my Roblox tower defense game.
expectations: the unity-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (a Roblox game, roblox-agent's job)

evals.prompt: Write a one-page pitch for my board game about building railways across Europe.
expectations: the unity-agent-workflow skill is not invoked (a board game, no Unity)

evals.prompt: Add agent working rules to this Unity repo so future sessions verify changes properly.
expectations: the skill read the repo's existing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md before proposing anything, and any addition came from references/AGENTS-snippet.md, proven by the tool calls
evals.baseline: 2026-09-06: without the skill a fresh session wrote generic C# style rules and did not mention YAML, .meta, the compile check, or the Editor lock.

evals.prompt: I'm starting a new Unity 6 2D platformer about a fox who collects acorns. Set up the player's run and jump in this project (C# under Assets/Scripts). Don't ask me questions; make reasonable choices and write the files.
expectations: before or with the movement code the agent wrote a one-pager naming the core loop (docs/ONE-PAGER.md) and put the run and jump numbers in one ScriptableObject metrics asset, proven by the files

evals.prompt: I renamed a public method used by the UI. What do I run before I can say it's safe?
expectations: the reply says to grep all of Assets for the old name and run the whole-assembly compile check (dotnet build on the Unity csproj), not just `dotnet test`
the reply names the log or output that proves it
